audit.why: content win[] gives Aatrox six stages and Zac only Two+ items, all seven whys agree, and the packet chart is identical. It also matches the mirror at audits/top/zac__aatrox.json, which frames Zac as a teamfight engager rather than a laner. Left untouched so the two directions stay aligned.

The spikes already carry Unstable Matter at 5s, Elastic Slingshot at 21s and the 120s Let's Bounce! against Aatrox's own 120s, and they are the right four windows. Stretching Strikes at 14s at rank 1 is the only cooldown still missing and it is the least load-bearing of the four.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] says he pokes with Stretching Strikes and resets off blobs, which misses the condition that makes the ability dangerous: the grab alone is a grab. It only throws two targets into each other if Zac then attacks a DIFFERENT enemy. In a solo lane with a minion beside you, that is a knockup he sets up in two steps and you can walk out of between them.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.' The mirror at audits/top/zac__aatrox.json independently reached the same finding and rewrote five fields on the Zac side around the two-target requirement, so stating it here keeps the pages consistent. The other half worth naming is Cell Division, which is where the blobs the entry keeps referring to actually come from.
audit.corrected: Two-target requirement stated in wants.foe[0]; Cell Division named as the blob source in the full-layer tldr.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer tldr is still the untouched template — 'Zac E, blobs, passive, and R' — and nothing in it says armour is the wrong buy.
audit.why: Unstable Matter deals a percentage of your MAXIMUM health as magic damage on a 5s cooldown, and Cell Division's blob heal scales the same way. Resistances answer neither. The content layer already gets this right by pointing at Grievous Wounds; the full layer, which is what the loading screen shows first, still says nothing.
audit.corrected: tldr rewritten around Cell Division, the 5s Unstable Matter and the percent-health point.

edits.before: Poke with Stretching Strikes, then reset off his blobs
edits.after: Grab you, then hit a minion to throw you together

edits.before: Zac changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Zac E, blobs, passive, and R. Aatrox wins by controlling spacing with his first two Q swings, holding E until the enemy punish tool is committed, and managing the wave so the enemy must walk into the outer edge of his Q. Zac wants to survive lane, farm safely, stack durability, and become more valuable in later fights than the early lane suggests.
edits.after: Zac changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Cell Division, which sheds blobs he walks back over to heal, and Unstable Matter (W, 5s), which burns a share of Aatrox's maximum health every cast. Aatrox wins by fighting on top of the blobs so they are never reabsorbed, spacing with his first two Darkin Blade swings, and buying Grievous Wounds early — armour answers percent-health damage least of all.
Blobs: stand on them to deny
